burst_construction: DIRECT_Q400_BURST keeps the dose (320 events), the quantum, the first force time (272) and the last force time (5376) of DIRECT_Q400_UNIFORM; only the intermediate distribution changes: 8 bursts of 40 events at spacing 4

endpoints.if_turnover_without_source: TURNOVER_80_NOT_SOURCE_ATTRIBUTED, and the ambient contribution A/T is reported explicitly

law_source: bridge00_harness.law_arms(), frozen Route E law measure

operator.atomicity: q = min(planned, sink_capacity, source_capacity) selected BEFORE any mutation; both sides move exactly q or the whole event is rejected
operator.payload: bare matter into state.m only; n and b untouched
operator.selectors_read: state.m, frozen masks, current track cells -- never any provenance field
operator.sink_rule: proportional to each cohort's local presence; never selects by provenance

organization.reason: no organisational observable or reader was validated before this mission; none is invented here and no organisational threshold is created after observation

parent.04R_data_role: DEV data used PROSPECTIVELY to choose the dose scale of this mission; no new pilot was run

per_arm_snapshots: t256, end_of_force, +16, +128, +2048, first failure, first threshold crossing

provenance.absorbing: every unit introduced by the operator is FRESH / DIRECT_OPERATOR_INSERTION for life, even if it leaves and returns
provenance.depth_partition: BOUNDARY=depth 1 from outside C256, INTERMEDIATE=depth 2, CORE=depth>=3
provenance.forbidden: no static per-cell `credited` counter exists anywhere in dr_core.py

quantum: M256/80 planned per event, FROZEN and IDENTICAL in every dosed arm; a higher dose means MORE EVENTS, never a larger amplitude

scaffold.definition: largest 4-connected set of tracked cells whose INCUMBENT mass alone clears THRESH=0.45
scaffold.qualifier: a residual below 0.20 together with a permanent incumbent core must be reported as BULK_TURNOVER_WITH_PERSISTENT_INCUMBENT_SCAFFOLD

sham: run to the longest terminal horizon (12544) so every arm has a checkpoint-matched control at its own terminal time

stage_a_gate.on_failure: STAGE_B_EXECUTED = false; DECISION = DIRECT_Q100_SIGNAL_NOT_REPLICATED or OPERATOR_OR_LINEAGE_INVALID; no higher dose is launched

statistics.forbidden: 144 logical trajectories must NEVER be reported as n = 144 independent
statistics.inference: n = 9 independent blocks per size, one LawSpec
statistics.pairing: every comparison is paired checkpoint by checkpoint
statistics.report: the nine individual values, min/median/max, treated-minus-sham differences, per-block dose curves, first threshold crossed, first failure type and time, remaining risk set at each dose

stop_rules: gate zero FAIL -> OPERATOR_DISPOSITION = PROVENANCE_ONLY_RELABEL, 0 engine calls
Stage A gate FAIL -> Stage B not executed
no extension beyond Q800 after inspecting results
t256_valid_required: 9/9 per size, else DECISION = PREPHASE_YIELD_INSUFFICIENT; NO replacement seed after observation
tracker: FROZEN largest bounded non-wrapping component; lineage classifier flags merger (track contains cells of a DIFFERENT previous component), split (previous track cells now span >=2 components), loss, reacquisition
